decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The linked issue says that before this change, the `applications, update` and `applications, delete` RBAC permissions also silently allowed updating and deleting an application's resources (sub-resources), to stay backward compatible [ev-3c176b54b173]. After the change, those permissions cover only the Application itself, and sub-resources need `applications, update/*` or `applications, delete/*`. The built-in role:admin policy gets those added so admins keep their current access [ev-e77b6a01ac75][ev-69d0a032cb9a]. The PR confirms that sub-resource permissions are now handled separately from the Application's own [ev-12fd720b7580]. Applicability: deployments whose custom (non-admin) policies grant `applications, update` or `applications, delete` without the `/*` forms. Consequence: if the operator does nothing, those users can no longer update or delete the resources of an application. Confidence is low because the excerpts are cut off and none of them names the settings key behind the changed util/settings/settings.go file.
